subject: Milestone-linked commercial plan (ramp + pricing)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@quantahealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed commercial plan & evaluation checkpoints

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our discussion I've attached a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that ties evaluation milestones to commercial checkpoints so we can align on timing, success criteria, and pricing as you ramp. High-level: 

- Evaluation phase (4 weeks): sandbox, integration tests, performance baseline.
- Pilot checkpoint: acceptance criteria; if met, qualifies for pilot pricing tier.
- Production ramp (3 months): committed capacity with two milestone discounts at month-1 and month-3 based on throughput.

I've attached two artifacts: SaaS_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with milestone definitions) and redwood-pricing-v2.xlsx (pricing bands and suggested commit discounts). Key asks for QuantaHealth: confirm target concurrency and preferred go-live window so we can lock the ramp schedule.

Proposed pricing samples (in the spreadsheet):
- 3-month commit: standard unit price, 5% ramp discount at month-3 if target throughput achieved
- 6-month commit: 10% overall discount with staged milestones for increased KV cache sizing and priority support

Next steps: can you share procurement contact + desired decision date? If procurement needs a redline or SOC2 evidence, we can route that quickly.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to walk the MAP.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

--Attachment: SaaS_MAP_v3.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)
--Attachment: redwood-pricing-v2.xlsx (Excel, 85 KB)
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@quantahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@quantahealth.com
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposed commercial plan & evaluation checkpoints

Marissa —

Thanks for the materials and the clear MAP. A few quick questions from our side before we send this to procurement: 

1) Can you confirm the unit price for the 3-month vs 6-month commit and whether the 10% is additive to any promo pricing?
2) We expect to ramp from a 50 concurrent-user baseline to 1,200 QPS over 90 days — is the pricing model linear or step-based for that growth?
3) SOC2 evidence: procurement will want the latest report and an explanation of retention/audit logs.
4) Do you have a proposed decision milestone date? We are targeting early September to conclude evaluation.

If you can send an updated pricing sheet and a short note tying the MAP milestones to the discount triggers, procurement will review. Happy to do a 30-min call if helpful.

Regards,
Elena Torres
Director of Platform Engineering
QuantaHealth
elena.torres@quantahealth.com

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Proposed commercial plan & evaluation checkpoints — pricing iteration request

Team — forwarding Elena's questions. Quick asks:

- Karthik: pricing modeling — can you produce 2 clean alternatives (A: conservative step-pricing tied to QPS bands; B: linear per-token with milestone rebates) and show net ARR for 3-month vs 6-month commits. Please highlight which is easier operationally for us (cache sizing, burst capacity)
- Rafael: legal/finance — do we have flexibility on the 10% for 6-months? If so, any mandatory conditions (min spend, termination terms) we should add to the MAP?
- Jonas: need sign-off if we want to offer an exception to standard rate card or accelerate discount timing.

Target back to Elena by EOD tomorrow so procurement has time to review pre-weekend. I attached the original pricing file; if we agree to a small concession we should also update the MAP doc to reflect the milestone acceptance criteria (to reduce ambiguity).

Thanks — Marissa

--Attachment: redwood-pricing-v2.xlsx (Excel, 85 KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Proposed commercial plan & evaluation checkpoints — pricing iteration request

Marissa / team —

I reviewed the ask. We can approve a limited commercial concession under these conditions:

- Offer: 10% discount for a 6-month committed spend (min $120k committed ARR over 6 months) OR 5% for a 3-month commit (min $60k), with the discount applied after the production ramp milestone is validated.
- Validation: acceptance criteria must be explicitly called out in the MAP (latency < 250ms p50 on 75% of test runs; integration tests passed; anti-abuse controls enabled).
- Legal: Rafael to add a short amendment referencing termination rights and audit windows; procurement will require SOC2 report attachment.
- Approval: Sales can finalize if legal adds the amendment and procurement gets SOC2 and the HubSpot record is updated with the revised pricing and decision date.

Jonas
VP, Sales Operations
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
